intro.text: A big, heavily muscled Azish man in Azimir.
An Azish master blacksmith who joins the defence of Azimir and becomes one of the Unoathed.

items.text: Newly named a master blacksmith after seven years as an apprentice, Sarqqin tried out for the military on the third day of Azimir's defence and met Adolin Kholin. On the day of the contest of champions he was among the soldiers who reached the bunker with Adolin and Yanagawn.

Sarqqin joined the team that retook the Azish throne, entering the palace through the smuggler hole and guarding the rear. When Mayalaran returned with dead Shardblades and Shardplate, he was among those who took up a set, and he survived the battle.

appearance.text: Sarqqin has a large frame and is heavily muscled.
